FIRE er et opdagelsesrejsende eventyrspil med et intuitivt design. Med få ord fortæller det en voldsomt morsom historie. Rejs ind i Stenalderen og mød den mest udfordrende opgave i denne tidsalder: Jagten efter ild!
 
 Helten i denne historie er den elskværdige, kaotiske neandertaler Ungh, som falder i søvn på hans første nattevagt. Den næste morgen følger katastrofen: ilden er gået ud, og Ungh bortvises fra hans landsby. Nu skal du hjælpe Ungh med at finde en ny flamme ved at gennemsøge alle afkroge af Stenalderverden. Uanset om han skal lede i maven på en dinosaur, ulmende vulkaner eller selv rejse gennem tiden, findes der ikke et sted, hvor Ungh ikke vil lede efter ny ild.
 
 Med et enkelt klik eller svirp kommer dine omgivelser til live. Med blot en smule logik vil du kunne løse enhver gåde, og der vil ikke være nogen grænse for dit udforskende gåpåmod, når du gennemsøger spillets verden: skyd kokosnødder ud af en mammuts snabel, forvandl dig til et dyr eller red skønjomfruen fra Octo-Bossens kløer.
 
 
    
 
    Ingen tekst eller dialog
   Naturlig og intuitiv styring
   Udforsk en indtagende, levende animeret Stenalderverden
   10 smukke håndtegnede landskaber
   Atmosfærisk soundtrack fra komponisten af ”The Night of the Rabbit”  
    
 
   
 „It’s [...] an intriguing evolution of the genre”
   
 
  4players.de 
 „After the presentation I would have loved to start right away.“

FIRE è un'avventura esplorativa ricca di enigmi intuitivi. Senza perdersi in tante parole, il gioco racconta una storia “selvaggiamente” esilarante. Viaggia all'età della pietra e affronta il compito più impegnativo di questa era: La ricerca del fuoco!
 
 Il protagonista della storia è l'adorabile quanto caotico uomo di Neanderthal Ungh che, durante la sua prima ronda di notte, si addormenta. Il mattino seguente la catastrofe: il fuoco è sparito e Ungh viene bandito dal villaggio. Dovrai quindi aiutare Ungh a trovare un nuovo fuoco, cercandolo in ogni angolo del suo mondo primitivo. Non importa se occorrerà cercare all'interno di dinosauri, vulcani incandescenti o tra le pieghe del tempo, non esiste posto dove Ungh non proverà a cercare il fuoco.
 
 Basta far clic o scorrere il mouse e l'ambiente circostante si animerà. Basta un po' di logica e sarà possibile risolvere qualsiasi enigma, senza porsi limiti allo spirito di esplorazione durante l'interazione con il mondo del gioco: spara noci di cocco infuocate dalla proboscide di un mammoth, trasformati in un animale o salva una bella fanciulla dalle grinfie di Octo-Boss.
 
 
    
 
    Assenza di testo e dialoghi
   Controlli intuitivi e logici
   Esplorazione di un mondo dell'età della pietra carino e vivacemente animato
   10 scenari magnificamente disegnati a mano
   Colonna sonora d'atmosfera realizzata dal compositore di “The Night of the Rabbit”  
    
 
   
 „It’s [...] an intriguing evolution of the genre”
   
 
  4players.de 
 „After the presentation I would have loved to start right away.“

title: Tales from Candlekeep: Tomb of Annihilation
description:
Tales from Candlekeep: Tomb of Annihilation is a turn-based dungeon-crawling game based on the Dungeons & Dragons Adventure System board games and developed by BKOM Studios.

Unique Quests: The procedural map generation allows every quest to remain unique even when replaying them multiple times.

Over 30 Quests: The game features a mix of Main Story quests and Side quests.

A board game experience brought to life: The game highlights most of the features from the popular board game, combined with features unique to the digital version.

Craft your way to Victory: Collect rare crafting materials. Craft powerful weapons and armors to strengthen your heroes.

On the deadly peninsula of Chult, an adventuring party must fight their way through dangerous jungles, labyrinths and dungeons to find and reverse the cause of the death curse. Choose to play as one or more of the four adventurers (Artus Cimber, Asharra, Birdsong, and Dragonbait) to face many perilous challenges and deadly foes throughout the quest.

While uncovering the secrets behind the mystery of the death curse, players need to craft powerful weapons, armor, and accessories in order to survive the encounters separating them from glory.

title: Resonance of the Ocean
description:
A sound reverberated from beyond the ocean. 
 
 
 At the edge of a desolate island, pick up what the waves wash ashore to make instruments. Use those instruments to answer the echoes heard from beyond the ocean.
 
 In this hand-drawn world, enjoy a soothing soundscape formed by waves, footsteps and the sounds made from things washed up.
 
       
 
 Resonance of the Ocean is a short adventure game you can play in 10 ~ 30min. This game was made in the 22nd unity1week, a Japanese game jam event. This version is updated with an English localization and with small changes. In unity1week, this game placed 4th in the overall ranking, and 1st for art and sound. Controls This game only supports keyboard controls.

title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
description: The charming community-building franchise returns for with Animal Crossing: New Leaf. The Nintendo 3DS entry into this popular franchise introduces a number of options new to Animal Crossing, including the ability to become the head of the village and boost its development, a way to install certain items in the village to make its characteristics more personalized for each player, and the ability to view homes of other players who are tagged through StreetPass connections.

title: Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair
description:
Jabberwock Island – once a popular tourist destination, this now uninhabited island remains oddly pristine. You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun...until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island’s mysteries. But be warned—sometimes the truth can be its own despair...
 
  Key Features 
    Deadly Island Vibes:  Murder is the only means of escape when you’re trapped on this island paradise. As your fellow classmates start dropping like coconuts, you’ll need to delve into each murderous incident, forage for clues, and interview your classmates to reveal the opportunity, motive, and means behind each killer case! 
 
  Tribal Council:  You’ll go head-to-head in all new minigames with the other students during the Class Trial, shooting down their false truths and using your evidence to uncover what really happened. But watch out! If a student is unconvinced, they'll challenge you to a one-on-one Rebuttal Showdown and force you to defend your argument! 
 
  Survival of the Keenest:  Match up your evidence with your fellow classmates’ arguments and determine who’s really telling the truth. Once you’ve got a suspect in your sights, turn up that tropical heat in a variety of timing and reflex-based game systems to reveal the ultimate truth and escape with your life!
 
  Steam Features:  Supports Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud with plans to add Steam Trading Cards

Isla Jabberwock: una vez un popular destino turístico, esta isla ahora deshabitada sigue siendo extrañamente paradisíaca. Tú y tus compañeros de la élite de Hope's Peak Academy habéis sido traídos a esta isla por tu adorable profesor para un "viaje escolar lleno de amor y drama". Todo el mundo parece divertirse bajo el sol... ¡hasta que Monokuma regresa para reiniciar su juego asesino! Atrapado en esta isla de los asesinatos, tu única esperanza de escapar es resolver los misterios de la isla. Pero ten cuidado, a veces la verdad puede ser desesperada...
 

 
Características principales
 
Vibraciones mortales en la isla: asesinar es el único medio para escapar cuando estás atrapado en esta isla paradisíaca. Cuando tus compañeros de clase empiecen a caer como cocos, tendrás que ahondar en cada incidente de asesinato, buscar pistas y entrevistar a tus compañeros para revelar la oportunidad, el motivo y los medios detrás de cada caso.
 

 
Consejo tribal: en todos los minijuegos nuevos te enfrentarás a los otros estudiantes durante el juicio de clase, donde deberás desmontar sus mentiras y usar las pruebas para descubrir lo que realmente sucedió. ¡Pero ten cuidado! Si un estudiante no está convencido, te desafiará a un enfrentamiento de refutación y te obligará a defender tu argumento.
 

 
La supervivencia de los más astutos: compara tus pruebas con los argumentos de tus compañeros y determina quién dice realmente la verdad. Cuando tengas a un sospechoso en el punto de mira, haz que suba la temperatura tropical en una serie de sistemas de juego basados ​​en la coordinación y los reflejos para revelar la verdad suprema y huir con vida.
 

 
Funciones de Steam: admite logros de Steam y Steam Cloud, y está previsto añadir cromos de Steam.

L'île de Jabberwock – destination touristique prisée autrefois, cette île désormais déserte reste étrangement vierge. Vos camarades de classe de la Hope's Peak Academy et vous avez été amenés sur cette île par votre adorable institutrice pour une « excursion scolaire qui fera battre la chamade à vos petits cœurs ». Tout le monde semble s'amuser au soleil... jusqu'à ce que Monokuma fasse son retour pour relancer son jeu meurtrier ! Pris au piège sur cette île où il faut se tuer les uns les autres, votre seul espoir est de lever le voile sur les mystères de l'île. Mais soyez prévenu : la vérité est parfois source de désespoir...
 

 
Caractéristiques principales
 
Île mortelle : le meurtre est la seule échappatoire lorsque vous êtes pris au piège sur cette île paradisiaque. Tandis que vos camarades de classe se mettent à tomber comme des mouches, il vous faudra enquêter sur chaque incident meurtrier, creuser à la recherche d'indices et questionner vos camarades pour découvrir le mobile, l'opportunité et les moyens derrière chaque meurtre ! 
 

 
Conseil tribal : vous serez confronté aux autres élèves dans de tout nouveaux mini-jeux dans le cadre du procès de classe, afin de démonter leurs fausses vérités et d’user de vos preuves pour dévoiler ce qu'il s'est réellement passé. Mais attention ! Si un élève n'est pas convaincu, il vous défiera en face à face au Duel de réfutation et vous obligera à défendre votre argumentation ! 
 

 
Survie des plus motivés : confrontez vos preuves aux arguments de vos camarades de classe et déterminez qui dit vraiment la vérité. Une fois que vous aurez un suspect en ligne de mire, faites monter la température avec divers systèmes de jeu à base de timing et de réflexes pour découvrir la vérité et sauver votre peau !
 

 
Fonctionnalités Steam : prise en charge des succès Steam et du Steam Cloud, avec ajout prévu des cartes à échanger Steam.

Jabberwock Island war einst ein beliebtes Touristenziel. Diese nun unbewohnte Insel blieb aber seltsam unberührt. Du und deine Klassenkameraden an der Eliteschule Hope's Peak Academy wurden von eurer super netten Lehrerin zu einem „Turteltäubchen-Schulausflug“ auf die Insel gebracht. Alle scheinen das schöne Wetter zu genießen ... bis Monokuma zurückkehrt, um erneut sein mörderisches Spiel zu treiben! Gefangen auf dieser Insel des gegenseitigen Tötens, ist deine einzige Hoffnung auf Entkommen, die Geheimnisse der Insel zu lösen. Aber sei gewarnt – manchmal kann die Wahrheit den eigenen Untergang bedeuten...
 

 
Das erwartet dich:
 
Tödliche Insel-Atmosphäre: Mord ist der einzige Weg, um diesem Inselparadies zu entfliehen. Nachdem deine Klassenkameraden allmählich wie die Kokosnüsse gefällt werden, musst du dich intensiv mit jedem der Morde beschäftigen, nach Hinweisen suchen und zur Klärung von Gelegenheit, Mittel und Motiv jedes einzelnen Mordfalls deine Mitschüler befragen! 
 

 
Stammesrat: Du wirst während des Prozesses in der Klasse in ganz neuen Minispielen auf Konfrontationskurs mit anderen Schülern gehen und ihre falschen Behauptungen entlarven, um dem wahren Geschehen auf den Grund zu gehen. Aber sieh dich vor! Sollte ein Schüler Zweifel haben, wird er dich zu einem direkten Gegenbeweis-Duell herausfordern und dich dazu zwingen, deine Sichtweise zu verteidigen! 
 

 
Überleben der Scharfsinnigsten: Gleiche deine Indizien mit den Argumenten deiner Klassenkameraden ab und stelle fest, wer wirklich die Wahrheit sagt. Sobald du einen Verdächtigen im Blick hast, solltest du kräftig Gas geben und mithilfe von zeit- und reflexbasierten Spielsystemen die volle Wahrheit aufdecken und damit dein Leben retten!
 

 
Steam-Funktionen: Unterstützt Steam-Errungenschaften und Steam Cloud. Steam-Sammelkarten sind geplant.

A Jabberwock Island já foi um destino turístico popular, mas agora é uma ilha inabitada que permanece estranhamente imaculada. Você e seus colegas da Hope's Peak Academy foram trazidos a esta ilha para uma "viagem escolar apaixonante de acelerar o coração". Todos parecem estar se divertindo... até que Monokuma retorna com o seu jogo assassino! Preso nesta ilha da morte, sua única esperança para escapar é resolver os mistérios da ilha. Mas não esqueça: às vezes a verdade pode ser o próprio desespero...

Características principais
Ilha Fatal: Assassinato é a única escapatória desta ilha paradisíaca. Conforme seus colegas começam a cair como cocos maduros, você precisará examinar cada incidente, buscar pistas e entrevistar outros colegas de classe para revelar a oportunidade, o motivo e o método por trás de cada assassinato!

Conselho Tribal: Você competirá de igual para igual com os outros estudantes em novos minijogos durante o Julgamento da Classe, refutando as verdades falsas e usando suas evidências para revelar o que realmente aconteceu. Mas cuidado! Se um estudante não for convencido, ele te desafiará para um Confronto de Refutação cara a cara e te forçará a defender o seu argumento!

Quando um suspeito estiver na sua mira, aumente o calor tropical com uma variedade de sistemas de jogo de reflexo e sincronia para revelar a verdade derradeira e escapar com vida!

The follow up to Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc. The main character, Hajime Hinata, a new 'Ultimate' student at Hope's Peak Academy. On their first day, Hajime and all of his classmates are taken on a field trip to the mysterious Jabberwock island by their anthropomorphic rabbit teacher, Usami. Usami explains that on this island the students are to have fun together and become friends to gather Hope Fragments. Usami's field trip does not go as planned when Monokuma appears and begins a new Killing Game. Anyone that wants to leave the island must commit a murder and get away with it. If the murderer is successful, he/she is allowed to leave the island, while everyone else is killed. When a murder occurs, the player investigates. After the investigations, a trial commences to determine who the culprit is.
2012年電子遊戲

青い空、白い雲… 煌めく海、広がる砂浜。
リゾート地として有名な南の島・ジャバウォック島に修学旅行で訪れた希望ヶ峰学園の生徒達だったが、学園長の悪だくみによって島に閉じ込められてしまう。
島の脱出を条件に、生徒達はコロシアイ、そして犯人を探し出す学級裁判を強いられる。
ハイスピードでテンポよく展開する学級裁判は捜査パートで集めた証言や証拠を弾丸としてトリガーにセットし、相手の主張の矛盾を打ち抜くことで進行していく。
渦巻く疑心。見えない狂気。極限状態のなか、進化した学級裁判が始まる。

brief:
Jabberwock Island – once a popular tourist destination, this now uninhabited island remains oddly pristine. You and your classmates at the elite Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to this island by your super-cute teacher for a “lovey-dovey, heart-throbbing school trip.” Everyone seems to be having fun in the sun...until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Trapped on this island of mutual killing, your only hope of escape rests in solving the island’s mysteries. But be warned—sometimes the truth can be its own despair...
 
  Key Features 
    Deadly Island Vibes:  Murder is the only means of escape when you’re trapped on this island paradise. As your fellow classmates start dropping like coconuts, you’ll need to delve into each murderous incident, forage for clues, and interview your classmates to reveal the opportunity, motive, and means behind each killer case! 
 
  Tribal Council:  You’ll go head-to-head in all new minigames with the other students during the Class Trial, shooting down their false truths and using your evidence to uncover what really happened. But watch out! If a student is unconvinced, they'll challenge you to a one-on-one Rebuttal Showdown and force you to defend your argument! 
 
  Survival of the Keenest:  Match up your evidence with your fellow classmates’ arguments and determine who’s really telling the truth. Once you’ve got a suspect in your sights, turn up that tropical heat in a variety of timing and reflex-based game systems to reveal the ultimate truth and escape with your life!
 
  Steam Features:  Supports Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud with plans to add Steam Trading Cards
